allocationBoundaries.materializations: resized accepted output: one base64; rejected dimensions: zero; existing small-input path: one
allocationBoundaries.buffers: At most two live encoded candidate slots, plus transient RGBA copy in hasTransparency, bounded by 4*currentWidth*currentHeight; garbage may remain until GC.
allocationBoundaries.native: Photon images explicitly free and pointers become zero on accepted/rejected/encoder/alpha failure; WASM capacity is not equivalent to a live image.
allocationBoundaries.preserved: Worker input copy+transfer, one worker/request and terminate/listener cleanup; read cancellation remains rejected until worker physically settles. Output base64 is caller-owned.
allocationBoundaries.warning: V8 sampled allocation decreases; native/ArrayBuffer allocation does not universally decrease because checking alpha adds an RGBA copy. Exact byte counts and sampled peak memory are reported separately.
allocationBoundaries.hot: No added per-delta/frame state; no object pools, caches, promises or controllers in encoding helpers. Existing once-per-image async/worker boundaries retained.

baseline.notes: V8 sampling excludes most WASM/native buffers; encoded/RGBA byte counters are exact JS-returned lengths. WASM capacity may remain reserved after free. Peak memory is sampled at encodes, not a process-wide absolute peak. Inputs and returned base64 remain caller-owned during GC checks.
